s1.syndrome_frame: Progressive neurological decline with earache and headache
key_facts: 2 months of progressive right earache and headache
1 week of intermittent hallucinations and nonsensical speech
No obvious external ear canal infection
CT scan showed otitis media, mastoiditis, and local bone destruction in the right ear
Brain MRI showed extensive area of hyperintensity and heterogeneous enhancement in the dura and pia maters

raw.syndrome_frame: Progressive neurological decline with earache and headache
key_facts: 2 months of progressive right earache and headache
1 week of intermittent hallucinations and nonsensical speech
No obvious external ear canal infection
CT scan showed otitis media, mastoiditis, and local bone destruction in the right ear
Brain MRI showed extensive area of hyperintensity and heterogeneous enhancement in the dura and pia maters

differentials: Chronic lymphocytic inflammation with pontine expansion
per_call: Chronic lymphocytic inflammation with pontine expansion

shortlist.label: Anti-NMDAR encephalitis
shortlist.why_kept: Positive anti-NMDAR antibodies and clinical presentation of progressive neurological decline with hallucinations and nonsensical speech

shortlist.label: Otitis media
shortlist.why_kept: CT scan showed otitis media and local bone destruction in the right ear, consistent with patient's earache

shortlist.label: Mastoiditis
shortlist.why_kept: CT scan showed mastoiditis, which can cause local bone destruction and is consistent with patient's earache and headache

shortlist.label: Candida meningitis
shortlist.why_kept: CSF next-generation sequencing positive for Candida tropicalis, which can cause meningitis and is consistent with patient's neurological decline

shortlist.label: Autoimmune encephalitis
shortlist.why_kept: Positive anti-NMDAR antibodies and CSF anti-AMPAR1 antibody positive, suggesting an autoimmune cause for the patient's encephalitis

raw.rationale: The presence of positive anti-NMDAR antibodies in both CSF and serum, along with symptoms such as hallucinations, nonsensical speech, and left-sided weakness, strongly supports this diagnosis. The improvement in brain lesion size and alleviation of meningeal thickening after treatment also aligns with the treatment response of Anti-NMDAR encephalitis.

rejected.label: Otitis media
rejected.why: While otitis media is present, it does not fully explain the neurological symptoms such as hallucinations and left-sided weakness.

rejected.label: Mastoiditis
rejected.why: Similar to otitis media, mastoiditis is present but does not account for the neurological symptoms.

rejected.label: Candida meningitis
rejected.why: The presence of Candida tropicalis in CSF next-generation sequencing is noted, but the clinical presentation and positive anti-NMDAR antibodies more strongly support Anti-NMDAR encephalitis.

rejected.label: Autoimmune encephalitis
rejected.why: This is a broader category that includes Anti-NMDAR encephalitis. Given the specific positive anti-NMDAR antibodies, the more specific diagnosis of Anti-NMDAR encephalitis is preferred.
